targets: minimum compression for stable front position

controls.name: Compression
controls.action: increase while watching combined reduction and gain recovery

controls.name: Gate
controls.action: leave off unless inter-phrase diagnosis exists

input_requirements: diagnosis must be present in P0 input
current local product must be available
level-matched bypass or justified monitoring comparison
route and latency budget must be stated
stop_conditions: tone sounds smaller at equal loudness

version_policy.match: Use deterministic mappings only for observed range: 12.7.0.209.
version_policy.mismatch: Keep capability-level recommendation, suppress exact control mapping, and require revalidation.

evidence.source_note: sources/音乐制作/插件资料/Waves/RVox资料.md

source_note.source_path: sources/音乐制作/插件资料/Waves/RVox资料.md

conflict_rules.action: defer deterministic control mapping and request revalidation

validation.boundary: Compression 0/-20 transfer and 64-sample latency tested; Gate not tested.

signal_position: 清理和基础去齿后快速增加密度；Gate 只做轻度句间下压。
可作为快速草混或与复杂压缩器对照，判断额外参数是否真有价值。
routing: 作为 Pro-C 2/CL 1B 的效率对照组。

controls.name: Compression
controls.meaning: 移动阈值并联动内部语音优化的比率/时间行为。
controls.action: 下降到响句达到目标 GR，再听轻句是否被过度拉平。

controls.name: Gate
controls.meaning: 按能量检测降低阈值下信号。
controls.action: 从关闭开始，仅推到句间噪声退后且尾音完整。

controls.name: Output Gain / Ceiling
controls.action: 只做旁通等响度，不用它制造更贴脸错觉。

controls.name: Energy / Compression Display
controls.meaning: 显示输入能量和总压缩。
controls.action: 用作动作线索，最终以音节与噪声听感确认。

parameter_start_points: Gate 关闭；Compression 下拉到峰值约 3–6 dB 总压缩。
Gate 只推到句间噪声轻退 3–6 dB，不追求静音。
listen_for: 轻句被抬后噪声/房间感。
内部固定行为对某些节奏产生喘振。
stop: 动态稳定且无明显门限动作。
继续下压只增加密度、噪声和含混时停止。
latency: Waves 当前技术表列 44.1/48 kHz 64 samples、88.2/96 kHz 128 samples；本机 VST3 Stereo 在 Ableton / 48 kHz 报告 64 samples（1.3 ms），与官方表一致。VST2 与其它采样率未测。官方未给出过采样开关。
